claim_ceiling: This candidate integrates the reviewed Definition, carrier, relation, ontology, Agent memory, learning, failure, challenge, and runtime models. It admits nothing, creates no authoritative instances or relations, changes no runtime, and does not establish a currently live service.
end_to_end_flow: Principal records Intent and owner-qualified Intent Resolution.
Project State supplies exact Definitions, artifacts, Decisions, evidence, relations, and canonical event histories.
Context Request resolves a Context View; Ontology histories calculate a Cut and Ontology View at exact cursors and digests.
Delegation and Agent Assignment bound one ephemeral Agent Instance and Agent Session.
The Session consumes exact Context and Ontology Views and owns short-lived Session Memory.
Agent Actions use exact Tools and Implementations and produce candidate artifacts, evidence, classifications, failures, challenges, or relations.
Only separately admitted Relation Kinds and Typed Relations create global connections.
Ontology semantic and governance events may record separately governed representations after validation and required decisions.
Explicit writes persist eligible records to Project State; calculated Views remain disposable.
Session termination expires Session Memory and the Machine Agent Instance.
A later Session creates a new Agent Instance and reconstructs continuity from new exact Views.
Operational Lessons influence later work only through explicit selection, Lesson Application, and Outcome Assessment.

integration_stages.name: Intent and resolution
integration_stages.rule: Intent states desired change. Intent Resolution and owner Decision select exact governed subjects and satisfaction tests; they do not prove delivery.

integration_stages.name: Durable Project State
integration_stages.rule: Cross-session continuity belongs to governed Project State and exact canonical histories.

integration_stages.name: Bounded read preparation
integration_stages.rule: Views select an exact cut, cursor, digest, exclusions, freshness, expiry, allowed readings, and forbidden moves; they are never replay sources.

integration_stages.name: Ephemeral Agent execution
integration_stages.rule: A Machine Agent Instance exists only inside one Session. Session Memory belongs only to that Session, cannot persist, and expires with it.

integration_stages.name: Attributable action and output
integration_stages.rule: Every consequential action binds exact Instance, Session, Assignment, tools, authority evidence, receipts, outputs, and residue. Output has no automatic acceptance or authority.

integration_stages.name: Classification, failure, and challenge
integration_stages.rule: Classification, failure evidence, impact, cause hypotheses, response, control intent, and contestability retain separate records and axes.

integration_stages.name: Operational learning
integration_stages.rule: Lessons are durable candidate guidance in Project State. Selection, application, compliance, outcome, causal benefit, and promotion remain separate facts.

integration_stages.name: Global semantic connection
integration_stages.rule: One of 40 candidate Relation Kinds permits an exact ordered pair and qualifiers; one Typed Relation records one global connection with independent identity and lifecycle.

integration_stages.name: Ontology representation
integration_stages.rule: Nodes represent exact subject revisions. Global edges project exact Typed Relations; local edges remain ontology-local. Equal labels never merge namespaces.

integration_stages.name: Event sourced state
integration_stages.rule: Semantic and governance events are canonical replay sources. Cuts and Views are calculated and discardable.

integration_stages.name: Runtime execution boundary
integration_stages.rule: Product approval, binding admission, runtime adoption, activation authorization, execution receipt, live service, migration, and cutover are independent states.

integration_stages.name: Persistence and termination
integration_stages.rule: Explicit governed writes may persist outputs to Project State. Session termination destroys Session Memory and the Machine Agent Instance; later Sessions reconstruct state only through new Views.

non_collapse_laws: Actor and Agent are classifications; Agent Instance and Agent Session are concrete carriers.
Machine Agent Instance is ephemeral; Project State is durable.
Session Memory is ephemeral; Operational Lesson is durable candidate guidance.
Agent Capability is technical attempt capacity; Product Capability is Product value.
Assignment states expected participation; Delegation bounds authority.
Classification Assignment does not establish identity, authority, conformance, membership, causality, or success.
Failure Mode, Failure Occurrence, Failure Assessment, Incident, and Operational Lesson remain distinct.
Relation Kind, Typed Relation, Ontology Edge, and local relation type remain distinct.
Semantic event history and governance event history remain distinct.
Cut, Ontology View, and Context View are derived and never replay sources.
Product approval, binding admission, adoption, activation, execution, live service, migration, and cutover remain distinct.

ontology_contract.namespace_rule: Equal relation text across Lab global, ontology business, and DomainSpec namespaces implies no identity or mapping.
